summary: SAIHEAT Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of an EGM to approve its acquisition of Canopy Wave Inc., an AI infrastructure and GPU-as-a-Service provider, via a merger with its wholly owned subsidiary. The all-stock consideration consists of newly issued Class A and Class B ordinary shares; no per-share price or valuation was disclosed. Canopy Wave generated over $15 million in revenue since 2024. The EGM is scheduled for August 26, 2026. The filing includes a proxy card and amended articles of association. Watch for shareholder approval and merger completion timelines.
